title: VoiceMailMessage - Data API

DurationInSeconds.description: The duration of a prerecorded voicemail message in seconds.

IsDefault.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsDefault.description: Specifies whether the message is the context user’s default voicemail drop message.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the prerecorded voicemail message.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The owner of the prerecorded voicemail message.

special_access_rules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **VoiceMailMessageOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **VoiceMailMessageShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
